<style>
  /* 1. Base hidden state for the product cards */
  .custom-pop-product-card {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    transform: translateY(40px) scale(0.9) !important;
    transition: opacity 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275), 
                transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) !important;
  }

  /* 2. Active state when scrolled into view */
  .custom-pop-product-card.is-visible {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1) !important;
  }

  /* 3. Hover pop */
  .custom-pop-product-card.is-visible:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.02) !important;
    transition-delay: 0s !important;
  }
</style>

<script>
  (function() {
    function initProductGridScrollAnim() {
      // 1. Find the specific product images using the class you provided
      const productImages = document.querySelectorAll('.product-media__image');
      if (productImages.length === 0) return;

      const targetCards = [];

      // 2. Step backwards to find the main container (usually an <li>) that holds the image, title, and price
      productImages.forEach(img => {
        const cardBox = img.closest('li, .card-wrapper, .product-card-wrapper');
        
        if (cardBox && !cardBox.classList.contains('custom-pop-product-card')) {
          cardBox.classList.add('custom-pop-product-card');
          targetCards.push(cardBox);
        }
      });

      // 3. Set up the scroll observer
      const observerOptions = {
        root: null,
        rootMargin: '0px 0px -5% 0px', 
        threshold: 0.1
      };

      const cardObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
          } else {
            entry.target.classList.remove('is-visible');
          }
        });
      }, observerOptions);

      // 4. Run the animation on the discovered product cards
      targetCards.forEach(card => cardObserver.observe(card));
    }

    // Run immediately and safely hook into Shopify's loading events
    initProductGridScrollAnim();
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initProductGridScrollAnim);
    document.addEventListener('shopify:section:load', initProductGridScrollAnim);
    setTimeout(initProductGridScrollAnim, 500); // Backup delay to ensure images loaded
  })();
</script>
